steps.name: Hugo's Call
steps.objective: Go to [Hugo] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: It’s been a while, little one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: I am the same.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what's going on?

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: This is an official request for help from the Union of Light.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Directly from the Union of Light?

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Yeah. Iris You know that abnormal phenomena are occurring here and there in the world due to your unstable condition, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: If so, the story will be quick.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's hard for me to say it myself, but I solved it twice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Coral City, even the events of the Amalun Desert... .

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Gndia, Eastland... . And this time it seems to be the Myrgandia region of Freios. Have you ever been there? I heard there was a mercenary group... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I helped out there for a while.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Then you might be the right person for this job. Then go and talk to the person in charge there and proceed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Is Parmilla the person in charge?)

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: Yuran said so. You take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's good to know, but it still lacks a lot of information.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: I'm sorry about that. Because there is still not enough information. Anyway, Iris will be taking good care of you while you are at Luman, so I hope things will be resolved well.

lines.speaker: 휴고
lines.text: You don’t have to report to me separately. more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, there's nothing we can do. Then please take care of Iris.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow!! It's been a long time, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s been a while, Parmilla.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What have you been doing all this time without even showing your nose?  Have you caught a goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Catching a goddess... .. Hmm, I found something similar in a strange place.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wow, you caught it anyway. Anyway, I didn't know that the person from Luman was %s. So are you happier?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, it just so happened to be like that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Even if our mercenary group wanted to investigate, we couldn't because we had some work in progress already.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: At that moment, people from the 'Union of Light' on the Eastern Continent came and asked if I had seen anything abnormal.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So I told him about the situation here and he said it was true.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This was an abnormality that occurred because Iris was in an unstable state, so nothing could be done right away...)

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Uh, %s. Are you here? By the way, Manager, how many requests do you get to find a cat that has run away from home?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: The Drulidge people would be better at finding animals... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: There are six cats left, so please take care of them. Carlo, yes.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: There are still six... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Calone disappears with an expression as if his soul has gone out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like your main job is finding stray cats.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehehe. You know that we are a group of mercenaries who will do anything for money.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now let’s get to the point.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hahaha, sorry. Then let me tell you about the mountain. Across the jade forest, there is a mountain with a strange atmosphere that seems to be full of monsters.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: People call that place ‘Monster Tree Mountain’ and rarely go there. It's nearby, but the mountains are rugged, so our mercenary group didn't go there.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: But not long ago. I started hearing strange noises. It was the cry of a monster that was neither animal nor human.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: The animals in the mountains and forests were agitated and came down to this area, making a lot of noise. The Drullizi people stabilized the animals and took them away... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Can you see the cemetery behind here? The Drullizi people told me to be careful because they felt the energy of the dead. I'm just checking.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's serious.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Everyone in the Mirgandia region is shaking with anxiety. Since we are doing our own research, would you please go to Monster Tree Mountain?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: I also heard that there was a strange-looking giant rock... . If you're not sure, check that out too. I think you would be perfect for that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then, be careful.

steps.name: hectic mountainside
steps.objective: At the entrance to “Monster Tree Mountain”, kill [Gardener Mountain Ogre] and [Boer Warrior] and report to [Rapidem].

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm, surprise!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Wait, what did I hear?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahhh, the rocks can talk!!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Shhh, quiet your tongue. Gya might make a strange crying sound again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes... ? This is my first time seeing the rock I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The name of the spirit is Lapidem. But who are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Lapidem the circumstances that led to this point.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So you're doing the work of a new goddess? And you came to check out the screaming Gya?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, Lapidem. I came because they said there was a screaming monster in this monster tree mountain.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm, it certainly seems like you are not an ordinary person. I was supposed to notice when I got this far, but I didn't feel a single thing.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: By the way, humans are calling this place a ‘monster’.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Actually, this place is not common. It's just different than other places because Goddess Gaia pays more attention to it.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: There are things that look scary and ugly to people. That's not a bad thing and it's not a sin.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Don't you draw it? You are not guilty either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm not guilty either... . yes yes?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You say it. Would you please do me a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Sorry for the first meeting. My body is like this, so I can't scold those who have lost their taste. I wish you would take care of the bad guys around here.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Maybe the girls went a little crazy because of Arborum. So just let me come back. Do you understand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will take care of it and come back.

steps.name: Spirit's Trust
steps.objective: After talking to [Harmonia] in “Belos of Memories”, report to [Mir] in “The Burning City”.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The kids have come to their senses. Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Because it was something I could do.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm worried about what to do with the Arborum golden horse. If I had been helping the goddess at the time, I would have been able to solve the problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it when you were fighting the devil?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's right. Several gods fought and disappeared, falling to Eastland. I fell here and almost died.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Goddess Gaia allowed us to become one with the sacred rock, so we were able to survive without extinction.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I can still clearly see the goddess saying sorry. Now that I think about it, I think it's time for you to wake up... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: When you wake up, will you go straight to the land of illusion? .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ugh, I'm so frustrated that I can't go anywhere. Still, I have protected this mountain for a long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… Instead of talking about the past, could you tell us a little about the current Monster Tree Mountain?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm sorry. It's hard to say that it's my fault that this happened. And we still lack ‘trust’… .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So, I would like to show you something that can fill my ‘trust’ a little more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I bring some delicious food? Or what more should I do?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't eat food... . Ah, then you just need to receive an imprint of trust from the spirits who know you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A stamp of trust?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: My young spirits these days don't know, but old spirits like me need something that can show 'trust'. It's called evidence, I guess... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The goddess made it this way, so there is nothing we can do about it. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I got it. So where should we go… . Should I go to the world of imagination? .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: What brought you to the world of imagination today?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's no different... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Harmonia about meeting the rock spirit Lapidem at Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Lapidem has faced a difficult task. I trust Adventurer, but I'm not sure if my level of trust meets Lapidem's standards.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia is the spirit king of harmony and stability. Then what about Geass?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geass is in a similar situation to me.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Still, there are people who are qualified to meet that standard. There is a being that Adventurer knows and Lapidem knows well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… , is it Mir?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, that's right. That child will be helpful to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Come to think of it, I heard you gave Mir a lot of good things?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, that. It's no big deal.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Thank you for caring for that child. Mir will be waiting for you, so go quickly.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer!!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What else is going on in the world of imagination? Or did you come to give me some beef jerky? lol… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll start by giving you beef jerky, so you have to listen to what I have to say. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Mir about Rapidem of Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Does it make sense that old Lapidem can't trust the wonderful Adventurer who provides beef jerky like this!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t think I can trust Mir… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Hehehe. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: (Mir briefly places his hand on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: This should be enough. I am a descendant of the great Pluton Dragon, so this is like eating hot jerky.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are they all describing it as eating beef jerky?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Because it’s delicious!! If you have something more delicious, please bring it next time!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I was already taking the beef jerky out of my pocket and eating it.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: You have left a stamp of trust, so go show it to Old Man Lapidem. Then you will admit it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Mir. I have a question. How did you meet Lapidem?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: When Goddess Gaia woke up, I received a message and delivered it to her. Now that I think about it, I think it’s time for you to wake up… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She is a goddess who sleeps and wakes up...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I would like to meet you if I get the chance. Then I'll go. Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: What? Thank you for the beef jerky!! Please next time too!!

steps.name: I need to sort it out
steps.objective: Defeat [Arborum] in “Monster Tree Valley” and report to [Rapidem].

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ongyeo?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: From the moment I entered the mountain, I couldn't tell if it was a dragon or a spirit, and I felt the trust of the child. But anyway. How did you get my trust? Oh, did they give you something to eat?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, lots of beef jerky from Luman… .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Gya has been coming to deliver Gaia's message for several years now, but each time the mountain's food has run out.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: This is the first time something like this has happened in thousands of years... . Shukridle and the Mountain Ogres, who must have had a Freeling in their stomachs, were upset because they had nothing to eat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha… , okay. Now, can you tell the story of this mountain properly as promised?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me solve the mountain problem. Because Iris’s work is also my work.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Okay. I will now properly recognize you as the goddess Iris's errand boy, so I would like you to help me.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It was a while ago. I haven't slept in thousands of years. I fell asleep in an instant.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It was just a moment. In a moment. A moment long enough for an ant to move one step.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Meanwhile, a strange energy hovered over the mountain and came down with a sigh. The stone, rotten branches, and miscellaneous things on the mountain came together and became that guy.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I didn't know why it was called 'Arborum', but I knew it the moment I heard its cry.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That it was created with power that flowed from a gap in another dimension, not from here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. That power... . Could it have something to do with Iris?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know the details, but it turns out that there is someone other than the Demon World who is targeting the Goddess.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The Agashura clan, the lords of the demon world, and beings from other worlds. What I can say for certain is that Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you doing this? Lapidem!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ugh. The Arborum is crying so loudly that even I, a stone dog, are in pain. Moreover, it seems to have consumed the mountain's energy.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But why are you okay? It’s a little unfair… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry about that and come to your senses!! I'll take care of that monster.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'll come to my senses until you come back, so make sure you catch that guy. I'm sorry!!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, and on the way, I also scold the guys who do bad things. Got it?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hey. It seems like the spirit of the mountain is finally returning... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been there. Arborum was definitely a difficult entity to deal with.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Thank you. I feel like all the fatigue has gone away! I won't forget you!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: But it's not over. Even though Arborum is gone, there's a lot of work he did.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… . If there are any left, where... Ah, the graveyard!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What do you mean by cemetery? You mean that place near the castle where a lot of idiots are gathered?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If they're stupid people, they're a mercenary group.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's probably like that. They said they thought they saw the dead waking up there.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It’s nothing… .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oh, that's right. There's something I couldn't say... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Which one?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Later, when I have time, would you like to come to me?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I draw it because I have something to say. It's not urgent, so think about it slowly.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: First, come and see what happened to the stupid humans. I'll see how it goes and tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will find out.

steps.name: Finding a solution (1)
steps.objective: Go to “Monster Tree Mountain” and talk to [Rapidem].

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, are you here? eww… .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's more serious than you think. I thought I was lucky that I could no longer hear the monster's cries, but the dead in the graveyard woke up.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: A scream was heard from the Monster Tree Mountain, and suddenly the tomb split open, and the skeletal wizards and knights emerged from it!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wizards and knights who have become undead monsters... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Monsters created suddenly, ghosts raised by the cries of monsters... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Even if you knock it down and knock it down, it keeps getting up. This is it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, we'll be stopping you somehow, so I hope you know how. Please do me a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Rapidem would know something... right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hurry. Hang in there!! Okay?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, don’t look down on our mercenary group!! Arcane, let’s go and show off our skills!!

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: Alright, boss! Body slam!!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader, Arcane... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Phew… . I can't help it. Even if I don't feel like it, I have no choice but to use that technology... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What is the situation?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The dead in the graveyard are waking up and coming out.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Even if I woke up before that, I wouldn't have gone out. The druids' prayers for the kings, knights, and wizards who died unjustly became a barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dead king and knight?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: A few hundred years ago, King Letum of the Kingdom of Belkia was a figure no less than a saint to his people.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: However, it was bound to be a small and weak country to the Old Empire, the Kingdom of Sylvaria, and other powers.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So he had a choice. It is to conquer the Mirgandia region.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Because of the past where the ancient gods stayed. The Kingdom of Belkia would have been able to move forward further if it had taken over Mirgandia, which has more magic power and resources than other places. but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what happened?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The region of Mirgandia was inhabited by druids for a long time, and they did not welcome other kingdoms and knights. Their mission was to preserve nature as it is.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: So, the Belkia Kingdom army and the druids fought for a long time, but it was the Belkia army that quit first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I think he probably went back thinking it wasn't Letum. You may not know this, but that guy named Nephandus killed them all.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: They even planted a curse there and turned them into undead. What you're saying is so terrible. Fortunately, the druids prayed for their souls to rest in peace.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Now that Arborum's roar has broken the barrier, what can they do when they come back from the dead? They're going to kill everything in front of them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I once defeated Nephandus, who had been resurrected as a lich.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Draw? That was you. Good shot. For some reason, that dirty energy appeared and then disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't be easy this time either.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Even if you are the goddess' messenger, it is difficult to deal with the dead.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Even if you did well so far, this time will be different. So let me help you. It's time to lend strength!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What about this power? The power that helps dead lives find rest. I've been doing this for a long time, so if they show up in front of me, I can bury them all... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Oops, that was a long story. Now, close your eyes. Don't float in the middle. Got it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I close my eyes and feel the energy of the monster tree mountain throughout my body. My whole body feels light as if I am embracing the nature of the world.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This power... ?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's temporary, but it'll help turn them to dust. What tongue? It doesn't go away quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, then I’ll go right away!!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Draw, draw. Good work!

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (Suddenly, a vague figure of a woman appears in front of Lapidem.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Huh? Could it be that Iris is a goddess?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lapidem, nice to meet you. And thank you for your help.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Anyoo. It's my job. Oh, there's one thing I didn't tell you, Errand Boy Hunty. Is that okay? Feel free to say 'sinner'.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I thought that was not my area to talk about.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, good job. I don't think he should know yet. Because I’m still figuring it out.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Because the goddess says so, I will keep my mouth shut like a stone.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you. In good shape later... … … … .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris, who continued speaking, froze.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (Iris remains frozen and disappears from Lapidem’s sight.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Even the goddess isn't used to it yet. Anyway, since the goddess said so, I may be quiet, but I feel a little uncomfortable... .

steps.name: king returned from the dead
steps.objective: Defeat [Retum] in the "Warriors' Rest" and report to [Parmilla] in the "Oscuras Temporary Garrison."

lines.speaker: 아케인
lines.text: My torso headbutt doesn't work... . These guys are amazing, after all.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Arcane, lightning!

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader, there is no such skill!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How's it going, Calone?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Oh, you're here. I'm really tired. Their skills are clear, but sometimes it makes me want to tremble at how pitiful they are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I think I get the idea.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Whoa… . There are too many numbers. How long have the Belkian Kingdom troops been here? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla, I will solve it.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is there a way? Is it really there? How to properly deal with a dead being?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He said he received help from the spirit at Monster Tree Mountain.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: After all, you are a great person. Do the work of the goddess, receive help from the spirits... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What are you doing now? Let's go quickly and solve it! Dealing with dead beings is not a very pleasant experience!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll come back. If there are any beings that escape here during my visit, please bring them back in as much as possible. Did you know?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Okay. Just trust me.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: (Parmilla looks at %s's back as he enters the warriors' rest area.)

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hey, Calone.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Manager. That expression has something to say.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: By any chance. Speaking of %s, is there information on %s in the Imperial Magic Research Institute?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: There will be all kinds of information about famous and unusual people.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Then isn’t it dangerous?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: %s… , Empress Kaina will be watching over this person, so unholy people will not be able to easily touch him.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: You can worry about that later, but for now, we should focus on this.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone is telling me something he likes after a long time. Hehehe. Then shall we go?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I didn't ask you to like it, but... . Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader, leader. Are you listening to me?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Now the knights don't move... . That means… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmilla, I'm back.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Also %s… . Everything has been resolved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it wasn't easy. This is the third abnormal phenomenon... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Wait, that's an anomaly. Does it keep happening?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Perhaps this will continue to happen for some time?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Is it related to that person you kept looking for in the past?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's related to Iris, but it's not Iris's fault. It's hard to say exactly, but just know that.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hehe, I understand. I won't worry about it because I think you will continue to resolve it well in the future.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Still, you must not intercept the work of our mercenary group. Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At least you won't run into anything, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: What is there to do now... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: There is a need to definitely investigate the Mirgandia area. Because no one knows what will happen or how.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hey, I don’t know. I'm tired, so I'd like to get some rest.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader! Are you listening to me?!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: It's a joke. joke. First of all, let’s pray for the peace of the men of the Belkia Kingdom. To do that, we need to bring in the druids, right?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ah, %s… . Go tell the spirit that you are grateful. I want to go, but I feel like I'm invading their territory. Sorry. And thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Anyway, I'm glad it ended well.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Ah, I just remembered something and there is something I would like to ask you. It's not urgent. If you come to me when you have time, I'll let you know what's going on.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Don’t be burdened. (sigh)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … … … … . (Pretending not to notice)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will go. See you later, Parmilla.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Goodbye. Whoa… . I'm going to get some rest.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: I tried to say hello, but you were already gone.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Calone, over there... .

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Yes, leader. Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Since we're in a hurry for money, why don't we go find the cat first?

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Ugh, okay. By the way, Commander, I understand that a deposit was received from the Empire a few days ago... .

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Hahahaha, I don’t know. I don't know either. So let’s look for the cat first. Ahahahahaha. I can't hear you.

lines.speaker: 칼로네
lines.text: Leader, leader! Are you listening to me? ha… .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What, is it all over?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think all the power you gave me disappeared the moment I defeated King Letum.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Good shot. That's good enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I will go now too. There's still work left to do... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Draw it. I come here to play sometimes. There's some delicious food, so if you feel like it, come and eat until you're full, okay?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You're not going to overdo it, are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, I can't eat that much. I'll come and help from time to time, so please tell me a story from the past.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Okay. Then go carefully. I'm not going out because I can't move.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: By the way, you. Have you ever lost your memory? I think the expression on his face is exactly like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, isn’t it? Lately, everyone I meet has been asking me that.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Maybe I can help you. If you're interested, would you like to hear the story later?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm not forcing it, so it's a good idea to look into it when you have time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Lapidem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't fall asleep like this time, and have a good night. Did you know? I'll come again next time.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Well then, goodbye. Heh heh.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (%s disappears from Lapidem's sight.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: This ominous smell must be Agash... . Looking at the dark color, I can see that he is a fierce guy.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Where do we come from now, Jeril?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (When Lapidem calls his name, a young-looking boy slowly walks over.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: It's a nasty beast after all.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's been a while, old man. But it's not me who's nasty, it's the old man's personality.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't want to hear you talk about inspiration. On the topic of growing old together... . By the way, what kind of bad thing have you come to do? And that too in hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Old man, are you saying this because you don’t know me?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I know you are different from those clumsy Agashura bastards.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hehe, there's something I want to check. What is this ‘sinner’ that the goddess was talking about? I came to ask something else... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: How much did you hear? And what else do you want to ask?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: When I say it's a different world, I wonder if it feels right.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: … Wait, another world? ‘Ah▒▒L’?!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The old man knows something. I took a quick look at it, but I was very confused. Hehe, what an unexpected harvest.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know. I don't know so I'd better stop. I don't know much either.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: There could be something that a spirit that holds all the world's wisdom doesn't know. it's okay. Because the inspiration response was enough. Why wait now?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: By the way, what would you like me to do with inspiration? You can't kill the spirit whose life God saved... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What is it? What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I'll give you a gift. A small dream that will help me quickly forget that I came here.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: (When Jeril smiled, Lapidem stopped moving as if it were dead.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Thanks to inspiration, I know everything about sinners related to 'A▒▒El' and I am very satisfied.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Inspiration, it was fun. Well then, take care.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: (Jeril, who was smiling faintly, disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (After a while, Lapidem comes to his senses again.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I feel strange... ? Who came and asked me? Did I fall asleep again? It's not like that... .

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Eh, I don’t know. Well then, let’s call to see if the Agu of the mountain are doing well.
